name: Fascism
description: A centralized, militarized state organised around a single national movement and its leader.

name: Communism
description: Rule by a vanguard party pursuing collective ownership and rapid industrialisation.

name: Democracy
description: Government accountable to an elected parliament, with entrenched civil liberties.

name: Neutrality
description: A policy of non-alignment, favouring arbitration and armed neutrality over blocs.

name: Monarchism
description: Authority vested in a hereditary crown and the institutions that surround it.

name: Authoritarianism
description: Strong executive rule justified by order, tradition and national discipline.
